title: When the Guru parents the lonely heart
subtitle: For the hour when dependence feels embarrassing
description: A quiet bundle for bringing loneliness into prayer without shame. It follows the helpless child toward the True Guru as protector, mother, father, and living water for the heart.

heroSource.shortMeaning: The shabad lets the soul come as a helpless child to the True Guru, protector, mother, and father.
heroSource.lifeApplication: Let loneliness speak plainly in prayer, then receive dependence as the place where the heart can blossom.

evidence.coreClaim: This bundle answers isolation with the shabad’s family language, where the True Guru protects and cherishes the helpless child.
evidence.turn: For when being needy feels like failure instead of the beginning of prayer
evidence.practicalImplication: Move through the linked steps by naming the ache, seeking holy company, and letting the Guru’s care become more concrete than isolation.
